title: Upper bound on the sample count
statement: Let $k,M\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $\delta$ satisfy $0<\delta\le\tfrac12$. The rational cast of the junta restriction sample count is at most $2^{k+1}M+16\cdot4^k B(\delta)$, where $B(\delta)$ is the number of failure bits used by the Fourier estimator with parameter $\delta$.
